description: Planet-in-house entries for saturn (Vol II), paraphrased. Same row schema as data/planet_house.json; remedies carry optional structured action/item/venue/duration.

rows.theme: Three times malefic when bad, excellent when well supported; a marker of wealth and long life when the Fish Line forms.

conditions.effect: Saturn with Venus in house 1 forms the Crow Line (misfortune, wealth lost, but long life); with 7 and 10 empty it becomes the Fish Line (wealth, property, lifelong comfort).
Fish Line: Saturn acts like a benevolent power and wealth flows.
Also forms a Fish Line for wealth, but with no guarantee for family members.
Mercury here acts like Ketu: a male child and, with a benefic Moon, large wealth for the parents.
Fish Line style wealth, effective when the agents Rahu and Ketu meet.
Enemies of Saturn in 4 make it three times malefic: education, wealth and wife suffer; ancestral business hit; father in poor shape; life still long.
Service matters doubtful; Venus and Mars results poor.
Earnings affected, discomfort to children, eye trouble, theft and deception.
Excess body hair marks a poor Saturn; liquor, romance and a west-facing house bring poverty and sickness around ages 36 to 48; education blocked.

remedies.text: For wealth, seek help of Sun items (copper, jaggery offered at a temple).
For health and education, apply a tilak of sweet milk mixed with soil from banyan roots.
For business and royalty, bury black antimony (surma) in the earth.

rows.note: Omitted from remedies: instructions involving liquor, feeding or harming snakes, or keeping animals. The book says to feed jaggery to a monkey; recast as a temple offering.

rows.theme: In service of Guru; Saturn here troubles the in-laws and rewards a detached, wise, self-dependent life.

conditions.effect: Looks simple but is wise; good health, kind and just, self-dependent, owns land, rarely visits temples; Saturn works on the native's Saturnine items.
Marked tilak of oil is inauspicious; milk or curd tilak improves Saturn and Jupiter. House 7 shows wealth, 6 sons, 8 lifespan, 2 houses owned.
Happy long life but father (Jupiter) is generally lost.
Sharp intellect and self-confidence.
Mars 8: rich or wise; Mercury 8: wise.
Saturn turns against the in-laws: poverty from the day of engagement, loss of male in-laws; Rahu 8 gives selfishness and suspicion.
Notorious, mediocre status without help.
Gambler, doubtful nature, expenses equal gains.
Loneliness, brooding thoughts, depression; sickness ages 28 to 39 in some cases.

remedies.text: Visit a temple barefoot and ask forgiveness for mistakes.
Apply a milk or curd tilak rather than oil.
Let a house come up when it is being built; it proves auspicious.

rows.note: Omitted from remedies: instructions involving liquor, feeding or harming snakes, or keeping animals. Advice on where to raise a daughter omitted.

rows.theme: Twice malefic when bad, but remediable; either wealth or sons, depending on conduct.

conditions.effect: Either many males or wealth; large family means less wealth, but life is protected if the native does not drink.
Supportive Ketu: wealth increases, repute as an eye surgeon, strangers help.
Without Ketu's support (or without caring for dogs) Ketu turns malefic: poor intellect, relations a source of discomfort, poor circumstances.
Poor results of Ketu and Saturn; a south-facing door and stone pillar near the gate harm family; a well on the property brings death and loss of wealth.
Saturn turns poisonous; destruction of wealth.
Enemy planets with or beside Saturn: total destruction, theft and loss.

remedies.text: Worship Lord Ganesha for Ketu's support.
Give free eye-care medicines or eye-camp help to improve eyesight and Saturn.
Feeding stray dogs is advised by the book.

rows.note: Book also suggests keeping three dogs; recast as feeding strays.

rows.theme: A watery snake: detachment from family, medical connection, mother and maternal uncle at risk.

conditions.effect: Sense of detachment from parents and romance; family members or the native may work in medicine; helping snake-bite victims is good; selling oil (Saturn items) can cost children.
Comfort of parents and in worldly affairs.
If Saturn is destroyed by drinking, killing snakes or laying house foundations at night, misfortune follows; mother and maternal uncle suffer, finances weak till age 36.
Moon destroyed: mother unhappy, maternal uncle harmed, water dangerous, loss of property, expenses on travel.
Milk at night acts like poison; during illness Saturn's things help but Moon things do not; womanising poisons Venus's results.
Robs others to gain for himself.

remedies.text: Throw milk (Moon item) into a well to improve finances.
Rear fish and give service or fair wages to labourers to dilute Saturn's poison.

rows.note: Omitted from remedies: instructions involving liquor, feeding or harming snakes, or keeping animals. Milk for snakes omitted.

rows.theme: A snake which devours children: children and houses are the issue; self-reliant native.

conditions.effect: Native is self-dependent, inquisitive and prospers; not childless; Ketu shows children and Rahu shows houses. Self-built houses harm children, houses bought or made by children do not.
Benefic Ketu: children grow; benefic Rahu: houses increase.
Children are protected and no remedy needed, but they may not help the parents.
Good luck at ages 5, 17, 41, 49, 53, 65.
First son's survival not affecting Saturn; family priest affected instead.
Blind snake of Saturn: even with many wives only one son survives to 48; building or buying a house leads to loss.
No wealth despite effort; Saturn's malefic effect lasts to the age of Rahu or Ketu (poverty).
Artificial Saturn of Rahu temper; items of house 2 hit during ages 9, 18, 36.

remedies.text: Keep items of Sun, Moon, Jupiter and Mars in the ancestral house (unless Rahu or Ketu is in 10, then drop Mars items).
remedies.item: Sun/Moon/Jupiter/Mars items e.g. copper, rice, silver, gold, sugar

remedies.text: Take almonds to a temple, leave half and bring half home (do not eat them); use 86 almonds in the stronger version.
Distribute salty items rather than sweets at a child's birth.

rows.note: Book also suggests keeping dogs; omitted.

rows.theme: Ink of destiny: one unit malefic; early difficulty that turns excellent after 42.

conditions.effect: Saturn here aspects house 2 in reverse and poisons its planet (even Venus); acts like Ketu; marriage before 28 turns Moon, Venus and Ketu malefic; after 28, sons for 24 years.
Ketu in 10 or exalted: travel benefits, son rises above father, all-round prosperity.
Bad period only until 42; after that Saturn wipes out misfortune and the wife is happy.
After 42 Saturn becomes excellent and makes up for everything.
Shoe and iron articles go bad first; buying leather shoes brings trouble in service and court matters; drinking and house-building worsen results.
Marrying before 28 damages mother and children around 34 to 36; build a house after 36 to 39, preferably after 48.
Elder brother and father suffer; with Rahu in 1, maternal uncle may go blind at 21.
Poor luck; loss of cow, wealth and women of the family, mother.

remedies.text: Float coconut or almonds in running water.
Bury an earthen pot of mustard oil at a riverside or tank; start Saturn work on a moonless night.
Worship of snakes for children is advised in the book; do it as a temple prayer only.
Use Rahu items, such as mustard, to protect Ketu.

rows.note: Omitted from remedies: instructions involving liquor, feeding or harming snakes, or keeping animals.

rows.theme: The pen of the Almighty for earning; wealth is certain, property is not.

conditions.effect: Strong-willed and private; builds wealth and rises fast with backing from authority; owns several homes and travels often. Works like an exalted Jupiter, with Venus as its base.
Results of Saturn, Venus, Mercury and Rahu are excellent, but a Saturnine partner causes loss.
High monthly income.
Wealthy, headman of an area.
Wealth stays only if a pot of honey is kept at home, otherwise it is lost after a grandson is born.
Liaisons with other women, drinking or a malefic Saturn harm health, children and money; ancestral house intact limits the damage.
Full of miseries when weak.
Eunuch or useless man; planets dormant at night.
Age, wealth, father and property adversely affected.

remedies.text: Fill a flute with sugar and bury it outside if house 1 is empty.
Otherwise keep a pot of honey at home.

rows.theme: Headquarters of Saturn: doubtful, relies on Rahu, Ketu and Mercury; many deaths when enemy planets crowd in.

conditions.effect: Proud, self-conceited, treats others as himself; Saturn here acts like Mars in the chart and relies on Rahu, Ketu and Mercury.
Alone, Saturn items or effects stay malefic unless a silver square is carried.
Numerous deaths and eyesight loss in old age.
Lifelong misery and poverty, relatives suffer too.
More planets with Saturn in 8 means more deaths around the native.

remedies.text: Carry a square piece of silver.
Bathe with milk while seated on a stone, so feet do not touch bare earth.
Float eight almonds or about 8 kg of urad in running water (up to age 39).
Sprinkle unboiled milk on the floor of the house.

rows.note: Book's 'give up drinking' advice paraphrased as plain advice.

rows.theme: Pen of God: wealth, land and a large family; excellent for about 60 years if charitable.

conditions.effect: Intelligent, blessed with three houses (building the third marks life's end), generous, gains through travel, comfort from parents; prosperity for 60 years if charitable.
Saturn nine times excellent, results like Venus in 2; Moon turns malefic.
Saturn, Mercury and Venus all excellent; wife from a rich family.
No deaths in the family, but a skylight in the rear dark room ruins everything within three years.
Good condition of progeny.
Saturn highly destructive like a plague-carrying rat; wealthy but cruel and licentious.
Delay in children, vindictive nature, rolling-stone fortune; wealth turns to poverty.
A house bought or built during conception, firewood or broken wooden furniture at home destroys father by 36.

remedies.text: Treatment of Jupiter helps if trouble comes after the father's death.
Avoid broken wood furniture and unfinished doors or windows.

rows.theme: Plain writing paper: extremely benefic when supported, poisonous when enemies join.

conditions.effect: Respect others and progress steadily; every 3rd and 7th year can bring peaks; wealth, respect, vehicles; long life of father and about 90 years for the native.
Comforts of vehicles all round.
Saturn like a sleeping snake, but good.
Without drinking, native stays lucky; if no house is built by 48, Saturn keeps giving wealth equal to its value; Mercury in 7 in transit benefits the in-laws.
All planets turn blind and Saturn becomes malefic.
Ill repute, risk to life up to 27, poor wealth.
Outdoor life is bad; stationary work is better.

remedies.text: Take help of Jupiter if the effects turn malefic.

rows.note: Entry text ends abruptly at the page break; low-confidence completeness.

rows.theme: Writes his own fate: controls Rahu and Ketu's conduct, religious bent, unfair-gain risk.

conditions.effect: Rich through unfair means, strong will, may inherit rather than hold property; Saturn gives a son even when other planets do not; the 40th year decides the fortune.
Pious Saturn, benefic planets in the house are exalted.
Royal treasure flows.
Native comfortable and able to comfort others.
Saturn dormant; with Jupiter in 9 all three become ineffective.
South-facing door depletes wealth; drinking and flirtation damage Saturn; a house built before 36 to 39 leaves the owner sick.
Changing a door's direction from east to west or north to south brings misfortune; ill-gotten wealth brings death.
Saturn dormant if houses 2 and 3 are poor or empty.

remedies.text: Keep a pitcher of water during auspicious work.
Pour fluid items such as mustard oil on the ground at sunrise for royalty, family and income.
Take help of Mars if Rahu or Ketu items go bad; Jupiter if no elder male lives.

rows.note: Omitted from remedies: instructions involving liquor, feeding or harming snakes, or keeping animals.

rows.theme: Pen of God, comfort: benefic helper that conquers enemies, rewards honesty.

conditions.effect: Conquers enemies, bold life, many houses built every 6th or 12th year, prosperity; rich but prone to cheating if corrupt; prophetic powers.
Sun, Mars and Moon absent from 2: comfortable nights and foresight.
Fish Line with a dark last room; excellent results.
Excellent Fish Line results.
Saturn gives excellent help.
Fish Line, blissful meditation.
Loss of wives, especially if the rear wall is demolished.
A liar, licentious or glutton loses Saturn's help; eye pain and wife's illness signal malefic Saturn.

remedies.text: Keep almonds in the south-east of a dark room.
Keep the rear room dark.
